messages:
incident-bot: Paging: DETECTED elevated tail latency for embeddings in eu-west1 affecting generation and streaming. Alert id: #INC-2029-euw1. Current impact: ~12% requests >2s. Paging @Priya K (on-call).

Priya K: I'm on it — acknowledging. Are we seeing errors or just latency? grabbing traces now.

Evan R: Looks like KV cache pressure + a batching queue spike starting ~03:04 UTC. Rolling jittered restart of the worker pool in eu-west1 now.

Liam O: Heads-up — if p99 > 2s for the hour for Dedicated customers that's an SLA trigger. Need affected request counts and invoiceable tokens by customer. @billing-bot can you run calc?

billing-bot: Running impact query, will post numbers in ~2–3m.

Priya K: Mitigation: scaled pools and restarted 3/8 inference nodes. Early telemetry: p95 improving, p99 still elevated.

Evan R: Confirmed. Also rolling back an autoscale config we pushed earlier that increased batch window. Command executed: ```kubectl set env deploy/inf-worker AUTOBATCH_WINDOW=16 -> 8```

Tasha M: FYI CS — AcmeFin (Dedicated in eu-west1) reported slow embeddings 03:05–03:20 UTC. If SLA credit needed, we should prep customer note.

Liam O: @billing-bot run this: ```SELECT customer_id, count(*) as requests, sum(tokens) as tokens FROM request_logs WHERE region='eu-west1' AND timestamp >= '2029-11-18T03:00:00Z' AND timestamp < '2029-11-18T04:00:00Z' AND latency_ms > 2000 GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY tokens DESC;``` Need top customers + tokens to estimate credit.

billing-bot: Query complete. Summary: total affected requests: 12,432; total tokens: 1,584,210. Top affected customers: AcmeFin (42%), Streamly (18%), internal-test (5%). Preliminary credit estimate for AcmeFin (prorated committed monthly): ~$2,150. Spreadsheet: https://redwood.sheets/credit-estimates/2098012345

Priya K: Note: our Dedicated SLO is p99 < 2s per calendar hour. We hit p99 = 2.6s for 03:00–04:00 UTC. Looks SLA-eligible. Need legal + finance signoff per policy. @Liam O can you open a billing ticket?

Liam O: Opening billing ticket #BILL-3998 now and adding owner @finance. Attaching the numbers and spreadsheet.

Evan R: Mitigation finished: p99 down to 1.8s by 03:18 UTC after restarts + batch window rollback. Root cause signal: autoscale change + kernel mismatch on some quantized shards. Will start RCA.

Tasha M: Drafting customer note (short): "We've identified and resolved a performance degradation in eu-west1 between 03:04–03:18 UTC that caused higher latency for embeddings. We've rolled a fix and validated recovery. Per your Dedicated SLA, we expect to issue a credit; billing will follow up with details." Edits?

Priya K: Suggest we add apology + next steps/RCA timeline. Edited draft: "Sorry for the disruption. Impact window 03:00–03:18 UTC; p99 above SLA threshold. We fixed the issue and are performing an RCA; you'll receive a follow-up and billing credit estimate."

Tasha M: Updated draft posted to thread: ```Hi AcmeFin — sorry for the disruption this morning. From 03:00–03:18 UTC we experienced elevated latency in eu-west1 affecting embeddings; we implemented a fix and validated recovery. We will provide an RCA and a billing credit estimate within 3 business days. If you'd like a live sync, reply and we'll set up time. — Tasha, Customer Success```

Legal: (via DM) ok to send. Finance: pls confirm credit estimate and proceed.

finance: Confirmed. Estimated credit for AcmeFin computed in sheet: EUR 2,000 (rounded). We'll create a credit memo once billing ticket is approved.

Liam O: Billing ticket #BILL-3998 updated with estimate and draft note. Assigning owner @ben_billing to issue credit memo and send customer comms.

ben_billing: Got it — will issue credit memo and send the customer-facing email using the draft. ETA 24h for formal comms. Posting confirmation link when sent.

Priya K: Internal ops note: mark incident record with "SLA credit: yes" and customer-impact=true. Assign RCA to Evan, ops action items to me, CS follow-up to Tasha, billing closeout to Liam.

Evan R: Filing RCA PR with config diffs. Early hypothesis: autoscale change increased batching window (8 -> 16ms) for cost efficiency; combined with a subtle kernel selection bug on quantized shards produced tail latency spikes under certain sequence distributions.

incident-bot: Incident #INC-2029-euw1 moved to RESOLVED at 03:20 UTC. Duration ~20m. Tags: customer-impact, sla-eligible, regional.

Tasha M: AcmeFin email queued? @ben_billing to confirm so CS can follow.

ben_billing: Email sent at 04:10 UTC. Posting message id and copy in billing ticket.

Priya K: Great work. Postmortem owners: Evan (RCA), Priya (ops remediation), Tasha (customer comms), Liam (billing closeout). Closing thread but keeping incident doc open for RCA. :thumbsup:
